english.note: Use 還原 as the all-purpose choice when undo means restoring something to its previous state or reversing an effect.
Use this mainly for restoring data, files, or a system from a backup or to an earlier state.

examples.english: I accidentally deleted the document; can I still undo it?
examples.traditional: 我唔小心刪咗份文件，仲可以還原返嗎？
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 saan1 zo2 fan6 man4 gin2 zung6 ho2 ji5 waan4 jyun4 faan1 maa3

examples.english: I used the backup to restore the photos.
